annotations.title: Brazil ANVISA/INCQS Supplement Purity & Cost-per-Dose Oracle

description: Queries the official ANVISA and INCQS/Fiocruz laboratory audit of creatine and dietary supplements in Brazil (RDC No. 243/2018, 41 brands analyzed) and computes deterministic cost-per-dose (3g or custom) vs. in-natura beef parity. Returns official gov.br/anvisa and incqs.fiocruz.br verification links, purity compliance status, labeling status, manufacturer legal name, and exact mathematical cost per gram.

dose_diaria_gramas.description: Daily creatine dose in grams for deterministic cost parity calculation vs. raw beef. Defaults to 3.

marca.description: Optional brand name filter (e.g., 'atlhetica', 'soldiers', 'max titanium', 'growth', 'integralmedica', 'dux', 'probiotica', 'dark lab'). Leave empty to list all audited brands.

name: brazil_supplements_anvisa_audit
